units: metres above the supplied ground datum; +x east, +z south

constraints.source: Supplied meta.json measured roof-minus-ground; public architect project height 75 m
Architect account; not inferred from flat app terrain
Manual cross-view projection of original n/e/w plus close150_h180 and h225; varies along facade
Original top/e and close150_h270; separate lower roof, not one continuous tall end face
OSM plan and original n/e/top; varies by level and perimeter
Photo estimate for exterior galleries; official retail levels B1/L1/L2

roof_control_method: Small manually chosen roof corners checked with perspective camera rays in original top and elevations; analytic faceted surfaces between sections, not dense photogrammetry or extracted mesh. Control section heights are estimates (typically ±2–3 m).
limitations: Approximate facade planes and fixed ground datum introduce uncertainty. These values are modelling estimates except where explicitly verified by the supplied measurement or cited architect/operator.
sparse_ray_check: Run python3 tools/sv3_measure.py for original_n reveal and upper-glazing plane intersections (2 m plane/pixel uncertainty).
